seraphine.title: Lady
seraphine.name: Seraphine Rosenhal
seraphine.backstory: The last of the Rosenhals: no money, a title worth nothing, and a crumbling castle that now belongs to a commoner in a hoodie. She spent her twenties watching creditors auction off the family silver while her cousins married into merchant houses to survive, and she swore she would never beg for a copper. She knows every noble in the kingdom—their scandals, their vintages, their preferred company—and exactly how to host them until they forget they're slumming. Hosting is the only pride her family has left, and she intends to be magnificent at it.

design.features: a family signet ring she never takes off

sig_seraphine.label: Faded court silks
sig_seraphine.prompt: an old-fashioned but immaculate gold-embroidered court dress, slightly faded

sp_seraphine.label: Rosenhal ball gown
sp_seraphine.prompt: a breathtaking crimson ball gown with the Rosenhal rose crest

unique.name: Noble Hostess
unique.desc: She knows exactly how to charm nobility.

ilyana.title: Lady
ilyana.name: Ilyana Silverbough
ilyana.backstory: The Pavilion's elven patroness for a century, though most of the staff only ever knew her as a signature on a ledger and a pair of pale gold eyes watching from the upper gallery. She funded its first stage out of boredom, stayed through three fires and five owners out of quiet affection, and kept the lanterns lit long after the novelty wore off. After a hundred years of paying for other people's evenings, she decided she would rather be part of it than own it from afar—and now wants to know how it feels from the other side of the curtain.

design.accessories: tiny pearls woven into her hair
design.expression: a serene smile that misses nothing

sp_ilyana.label: Moonsilk gown
sp_ilyana.prompt: a gown of shimmering moonsilk that is more light than fabric

sylphine.note: The Pavilion's patroness has watched Sylphine dance for decades.

unique.name: Century of Poise
unique.desc: A hundred years of patronage give her unshakable poise.

ines.name: Ines Varga
ines.backstory: A former ghost hunter who took a contract to exorcise Hollowmere Manor, kicked in the front door with a silver dagger and three pouches of rock salt, and stayed to make amends. On her first night Vesper offered her chamomile tea instead of fleeing, and Ines has never quite recovered from the embarrassment—or the relief of not having to swing at anything for once. She still sleeps with that silver dagger under her pillow out of stubborn habit, still checks every lock twice before dawn, and now considers the manor and everyone in it her personal responsibility.

design.features: a thin scar along her jaw

sig_ines.label: Ghost-hunter's coat
sig_ines.prompt: a long black hunter's coat with silver buckles and a bandolier of charms

vesper.note: She came to exorcise Vesper. Vesper has not forgotten.

unique.name: Ghost Hunter's Eye
unique.desc: She notices danger before anyone else does.

vharra.name: Vharra
vharra.backstory: The Underdistrict's undisputed landlord for the better part of a century, until she got bored of collecting rent and decided it would be more fun to make it herself. She owns half the lanes down there—mostly in deeds won over late-night card games—and the other half owe her favors she prefers to call in with interest. Nothing moves beneath the Veil without her hearing about it before morning. She treats Sam's debts as a personal game, keeps score in a crimson ledger for fun, and never misses a chance to remind him who really holds the paper.

design.accessories: heavy gold horn rings and piercings

unique.desc: She always takes a little more from every deal, and nobody minds.
